mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (measured by sign distribution over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in a month (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down >0.5% from prior month) fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to stagflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and INDPRO declines from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and INDPRO declines from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits (HOUST) above their 12-month moving average signal strong housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through boosted consumer confidence and capital expenditure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly rise > 0.4 percentage points) signals imminent central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.4pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate hidden labor market contraction, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and UNRATE (both down from prior month) fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) combined with strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 1.5% qoq) reverses supply-side headwinds, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as growth offsets production declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 1.5% qoq and INDPRO declines from prior month.
